description: Create a new DNS zone. Use mode "primary" for zones managed at Hetzner, or "secondary" with primary_nameservers to transfer the zone from external primaries. A primary zone can optionally be initialized from a zone file. Creating a zone with primary_nameservers or a zonefile asks a person first — those two carry the whole content of the zone, exactly like change_primary_nameservers and import_zonefile do.

confirm_token.description: Confirmation token from the previous call of this same tool with identical arguments. Omit on the first call — the server then returns a token that is valid for a few minutes.

name.description: Name of the zone, e.g. "example.com" (without trailing dot)

primary_nameservers.description: Primary nameservers to transfer the zone from (secondary zones)

address.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address of the primary nameserver

tsig_key.description: TSIG key to use for the zone transfer. Treat as a secret — it becomes part of the conversation context.

ttl.description: Default Time To Live in seconds

zonefile.description: Zone file (BIND format) to initialize a primary zone with. Ignored for secondary zones.

name: create_zone
title: Create DNS zone
